The spec declares no dependency table — the code declares its dependencies by `@dep:`.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Checker | `dependency-honored` |
| Confronts | `spec` |
| Blocking by default — new project | yes |
| Blocking by default — existing project | no — informs |

## How it measures

A spec that still carries a Dependencies table — rows opening with a `DEPn` — declares, in the
artifact that comes first, what only the code can know. The gate names it as a divergence to
migrate: `anchors migrate` removes the table and rewrites the `DEPn` a rule cites. A spec with
no table passes.

## Declaring it

```yaml
gates:
  - name: dependency-honored
    on: [spec]
    check: dependency-honored
```
